name: issue_tracker
description: A minimal, full-stack issue tracking platform built as a coding challenge for Zartek Technologies. Designed with clean architecture, type safety, and AI-powered analysis.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
